problemStatement: Assistant turns currently conflate observed provider reasoning, displayable reasoning, elapsed time, and inspectable Activity content. That makes metadata-only or empty reasoning render as an interactive empty panel and allows sub-second durations to become `Thought for 0s`; the fallback live state also still has a separate `Generating` shimmer with a blinking caret. The product convention is that every active assistant turn begins as `Thinking`, while the same composable status surface must be able to evolve into richer labels such as search, file, image, approval, and tool activity without making non-inspectable states interactive.
solutionSummary: Introduce a provider-neutral assistant-activity presentation domain that separates reasoning evidence, displayable reasoning blocks, passive timing, live status copy, and non-empty disclosure sections. Keep `Thinking` as the universal pre-content live label, remove the `Generating` caret presentation, and allow the live label resolver to compose tool-aware status copy from normalized activity facts. Track server reasoning duration across start/end intervals, use a one-second floor policy, and preserve opaque provider metadata durably without exposing empty Reasoning sections. Render the normalized union through one composable indicator component so label, motion, interactivity, chevron, panel contents, and accessibility semantics cannot drift.
currentStateAnalysis: `deriveReasoningView` reduces all reasoning parts to idle/thinking/complete plus an opaque boolean, while `deriveAssistantTurnIndicator` maps submitted and reasoning to an interactive Thinking trigger and maps an otherwise empty live stream to a separate Generating loader. Completed reasoning always wins the settled trigger, `Math.round` can create zero-second labels, and ActivityPanelTrigger always renders button/disclosure semantics. `useActivityPanel` passes raw reasoning/tool/source facts, but ActivityPanel independently creates an empty opaque Reasoning row and does not consume its `steps` prop. The server starts timing on the first reasoning delta, including Anthropic signature-only empty deltas, and stops at the first text delta rather than tracking multiple or interleaved reasoning intervals.

operationalConsiderations.externalSystemAccess: No new external system is introduced. The server continues consuming the existing AI SDK stream and persisting through the existing Convex durable-turn runtime; provider calls, credentials, and network access remain unchanged.
operationalConsiderations.crossRuntimeContracts: The server produces AI SDK UI-message parts plus message metadata and the browser consumes both. Patch 3 keeps the existing optional `reasoningDurationMs` wire key and number shape for backward compatibility while changing only how the value is measured; Patch 2 makes old, missing, zero, negative, and invalid values normalize safely, so historical records and in-flight records from either code version remain renderable. Opaque signed, encrypted, and redacted reasoning parts remain byte-for-byte available to the provider replay adapters.
operationalConsiderations.failureBehavior: Abort, stop, timeout, disconnect, and stream error close any active reasoning interval at the last observed terminal timestamp and then use the existing durable terminal path. Missing or malformed durations degrade to no duration label; incomplete or frozen reasoning parts settle from the client/durable terminal status and never keep a timer alive. If Activity contains no non-empty section, the presentation cannot construct a disclosure, preventing empty-panel recovery paths.
operationalConsiderations.concurrencyAndIdempotency: The reasoning interval tracker is request-local and idempotent for duplicate start/end events: duplicate starts for an active block and ends for unknown blocks are ignored, and overlapping active blocks are measured as the union of wall-clock intervals rather than double-counted. Client derivation remains pure per render because AI SDK parts mutate in place; selected-path reconciliation and historical panel targeting keep their existing identity and liveness contracts.
operationalConsiderations.rollbackStrategy: No schema migration or destructive data rewrite is required. `reasoningDurationMs` remains backward-compatible, so reverting the patches restores the old presentation without stranding records; newly measured values are still finite millisecond numbers that old clients can read. The gameplan is atomic and should be reverted as a unit if necessary.

mergabilityStrategy.featureFlagStrategy: No feature flag. This is a correction to the canonical assistant-turn presentation contract, and running old and new derivations simultaneously would recreate inconsistent labels, panel sections, and accessibility semantics.
mergabilityStrategy.patchOrderingStrategy: Patch 1 adds pending behavior tests. Patch 2 introduces and proves the pure normalized presentation domain without wiring production components. Patch 3 replaces server reasoning timing while preserving the wire shape. Patch 4 performs the single production cutover, removes the Generating caret path, renders the composable Thinking/Activity surface, updates fixtures/docs, and enables the remaining tests. The dependency graph is intentionally sequential because the patches touch shared reasoning contracts and must merge without semantic skew.

functionalChanges.description: Every submitted or otherwise content-empty live assistant turn displays `Thinking`; the `Generating` shimmer and blinking caret presentation no longer appear.

The live thinking surface can replace its label with normalized activity-aware copy such as searching, generating an image, awaiting approval, or using a named tool without changing its renderer or accessibility contract.
Completed opaque reasoning with no displayable text and less than one second of valid duration renders no reasoning label, chevron, focus target, or Reasoning panel section.
Completed opaque reasoning with no displayable text and at least one second of valid duration renders a passive `Thought for Ns` label with no disclosure interaction or semantics.
Visible reasoning remains inspectable during streaming and after completion, including stopped, aborted, failed, regenerated, reloaded, and historical turns.
Meaningful sources, tool calls, approvals, image/search activity, and tool errors retain an interactive Activity affordance even when reasoning is absent, empty, opaque, or suppressed.
Completed duration labels appear only after a full second and use floor semantics, so `Thought for 0s` is impossible and 1000-1999 ms displays as 1s.
Persisted reasoning duration measures the union of reasoning start/end intervals across multiple and interleaved blocks instead of starting on metadata-only deltas and ending at the first text delta.
Only presentations with at least one inspectable Activity section render as buttons with chevrons, focus behavior, `aria-expanded`, and `aria-controls`; passive labels render as ordinary text.
Activity panels exclude empty Reasoning sections and expose the same normalized sections on live settlement and durable historical hydration.

contextResources.why: Defines the per-render assistant view, canonical phase, in-place AI SDK mutation rule, client-owned liveness, historical status handling, and durable selected-path reconciliation that all presentation patches must preserve.

These suites and fixtures encode current lifecycle, memoization, historical targeting, trigger, panel, and SDK seam behavior; Patch 1 must mark the new expectations and later patches must implement them without broad snapshots.
The official AI SDK start/delta/end protocol and onChunk contract constrain the request-local reasoning interval tracker and the UI-message part lifecycle.

Primary provider documentation establishes that visible summaries, encrypted/signed/redacted continuation metadata, and internal reasoning activity are distinct; normalization must remain provider-neutral and must not delete opaque replay data.

acceptanceCriteria: No production assistant state renders the word `Generating` with a blinking or streaming caret; submitted and content-empty live turns render `Thinking`.
The live status renderer accepts normalized label data and can present Thinking, search, image, approval, and tool-aware statuses without provider-name branches or raw-part inspection.
Empty and whitespace-only reasoning under 1000 ms produces no completed reasoning UI.
Empty and whitespace-only reasoning at or above 1000 ms produces passive, non-focusable `Thought for Ns` text with no chevron or disclosure ARIA.
Visible reasoning produces an interactive disclosure with a non-empty Reasoning section regardless of duration availability.
Sources, tools, approvals, image/search activity, and tool failures remain inspectable independently of reasoning visibility.
A disclosure presentation is constructible only when its section list is non-empty, and ActivityPanel renders exactly those sections.
Completed duration uses finite non-negative milliseconds, a 1000 ms visibility threshold, and floor conversion; `Thought for 0s` cannot be rendered.
Live reasoning timing is monotonic and starts only on observed reasoning lifecycle evidence; submitted Thinking without reasoning evidence does not start a fake reasoning timer.
Server timing handles multiple, interleaved, duplicate, aborted, and unterminated reasoning blocks without counting overlapping intervals twice.
Signed, encrypted, redacted, and empty provider reasoning parts remain durable and replayable even when they are not presented.
Live settlement, stop, abort, failure, background completion, selected-path reconciliation, reload, regeneration, and branch switching derive the same terminal presentation from the same facts.
Passive states are absent from keyboard order and carry no `aria-expanded` or `aria-controls`; interactive states retain native button and focus-return behavior.
Reduced-motion users receive no shimmer or chevron motion while status text remains visible.
Focused unit, component, runtime seam, and browser fixture verification passes without modifying unrelated dirty files.

explicitOpinions.opinion: Thinking is the universal initial live assistant label; remove the Generating caret convention.
explicitOpinions.rationale: This is the explicit product convention. It also avoids a noisy Thinking-to-Generating transition when the provider emits no visible reasoning. Thinking here names the assistant's active state, not proof that displayable chain-of-thought exists.

explicitOpinions.opinion: Model live status, passive timing, and inspectable disclosure as distinct presentation variants rendered by one composable component.
explicitOpinions.rationale: A single renderer can evolve from Thinking to richer activity copy while the discriminated union prevents passive opaque reasoning from inheriting hover, focus, chevron, or disclosure semantics.

explicitOpinions.opinion: Preserve opaque reasoning parts and provider metadata; suppress them only in presentation.
explicitOpinions.rationale: Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, xAI, and OpenRouter can use signed, encrypted, redacted, or summary-free reasoning for continuation and tool replay. UI cleanup must not corrupt durable model history.

explicitOpinions.opinion: Use a 1000 ms threshold with floor semantics for completed labels.
explicitOpinions.rationale: The UI never claims a full second before one elapsed and can never render Thought for 0s. Visible reasoning remains inspectable below the threshold but omits duration copy.

explicitOpinions.opinion: Activity labels describe the work currently visible or inspectable, while provider identity remains outside presentation logic.
explicitOpinions.rationale: Tool and source facts already normalize across providers. A data-driven label resolver can later add copy such as searching online for a query or checking files without adding provider conditionals to components.

> Every live turn has a status presentation rather than no presentation.

all t: Turn, presentation t = passive | duration-seconds t > 0.
